title: Add visible NO button beside YES and preserve evasive moving/label behavior

requirements.summary: Show a clearly labeled NO button next to the YES! button on initial render with responsive wrapping/stacking.
acceptanceCriteria: On initial render, the NO button is visible and placed next to the YES button (with responsive behavior for small screens).
The NO button is visually distinct but consistent with the existing romantic theme and button styling.
The YES button remains clickable and continues to trigger the acceptance flow unchanged.

file_operations.description: Update the proposal screen button area to render a visible "NO" button side-by-side with the existing "YES!" button using responsive layout (row on larger screens; wraps/stacks on small screens). Use the shadcn-ui Button component (and/or composed styling consistent with existing Tailwind romantic theme) to keep visuals consistent; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure the YES button remains unchanged in behavior and still triggers onAccept.

requirements.summary: Make the NO button evade interaction by moving within safe on-screen bounds and changing its English label on each hover/click/focus attempt.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to click, hover, or focus the NO button triggers a reposition to a new on-screen location within safe bounds.
Each interaction increments an attempt count and updates the button label to a different English message (with the initial label reading "NO").
The NO button never becomes partially/fully off-screen and remains reachable/visible after it moves.

file_operations.description: Refactor the existing decline/evasive logic so the same "NO" button shown next to YES becomes evasive: on click, hover, or keyboard focus it moves to a new position within the visible container/viewport safe bounds and updates its label to a different English phrase each time (initial label exactly "NO"). Clamp computed positions to avoid going off-screen and avoid overlapping the top header area (safe padding). Preserve smooth motion transitions, ensure the button stays focusable/visible after moving, and keep behavior contained to the existing proposal screen. Verify any shadcn-ui Button component usage instructions before implementing.
